narrative: This batch tightens the corpus's protocol map: AG-UI, A2UI, MCP Apps, CopilotKit, and OpenUI now all cross-reference the Model Context Protocol as the base layer the generative-UI family extends, and AHP's mcp:// side-channel is explicitly documented as relaying MCP's wire format. The tooling layer expands in parallel — AG-UI gains a source-backed Kotlin SDK with stable Android/iOS/JVM targets, OpenCode gains its official Go SDK and ecosystem catalogue, Mastra's page adds 1.0-stable/A2A/AI-Tracing runtime signals, and the factory page folds in gh-aw's CI-native agent workflows. The batch also documents the wiki's own maintenance tooling: a new OpenWiki page, plus open questions about whether it emits OKF v0.1 or v0.2 and what its current release is.

entries.title: Agentic SDLC factory toolchain
entries.summary: The factory toolchain page now folds in the CI-native gh-aw workflow layer (Markdown workflow files compiled into GitHub Actions) and the followed engineering-blog feeds, and clarifies that AHP's mcp:// side-channel relays the Model Context Protocol wire format. Readers tracking the SDLC factory get the first source-backed blog-feed signals: gh-aw makes agent workflows CI-native, complementing the ACP/AHP session protocols.

entries.title: Generative-UI ecosystem
entries.summary: The comparison table now reflects the AG-UI Kotlin SDK (stable Android/iOS/JVM targets, THINKING_ telemetry surfaced for UIs) and MCP Apps' JSON-RPC-over-postMessage handshake details, and adds Cedar-OS as a third-party watchlist entrant in the same provider/frontend space. The ecosystem map is updated with the new SDK evidence and one more multi-frontend framework.

entries.title: CopilotKit (generative-UI frontend stack)
entries.summary: CopilotKit's relationship section now explicitly ties AG-UI and MCP Apps back to the Model Context Protocol base: MCPAppsMiddleware renders MCP Apps UIs served over MCP, and MCP Apps extends MCP. This clarifies the protocol stack CopilotKit consumes.

entries.title: Effect
entries.summary: The durable-execution surface (DurableQueue ported to v4, @effect/workflow alpha) was reconfirmed by the 2026-08-17 pull, with Layer.suspend re-verified from the official recap. The v4 beta durable-execution claims now have two independent pulls behind them.

entries.title: Mastra agentic-UI integration
entries.summary: The page gains a runtime-maturity section: Mastra 1.0 stable, A2A support for cross-framework multi-agent systems, and AI Tracing over OpenTelemetry, all source-backed from the Mastra blog feed. Cedar-OS is upgraded from a docs mention to a full third-party adoption signal with its own watchlist entry.

entries.title: OpenCode
entries.summary: The page now covers the official Go SDK (opencode.ai/docs/go) with its model/provider table (Grok 4.5, GPT 5.6 Luna, GLM-5.x, Kimi K3) and the ecosystem catalogue (opencode-background-agents, opencode-notify, opencode-workspace, octto browser UI), plus a community REST client (anomalyco/opencode-sdk-js) as traction evidence. The Claude OAuth removal note is now pinned to headroomlabs-ai/headroom issue #78.

entries.title: OpenUI (Open Standard for Generative UI)
entries.summary: Cross-reference fix: the MCP Apps iframe/embedding thread now links to the Model Context Protocol base page. No substantive change.

entries.title: OpenWiki
entries.summary: New page: OpenWiki is the langchain-ai self-maintaining-wiki CLI (MIT, npm, TypeScript) that maintains this corpus — code and personal modes, connectors for local git/Notion/Slack/Gmail/X/Web Search/Hacker News/Custom MCP, OKF v0.1 output with validated Mermaid diagrams, an interactive visualizer, and CI self-update workflows for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Bitbucket Pipelines. Readers get the tooling layer behind this wiki documented for the first time.

entries.title: Pi SDK
entries.summary: The Pi SDK extension ecosystem list adds macos-dev-code, a SwiftUI-first macOS coding-guidance package that uses the platform SDK. One more embedding route into the Pi agent.

entries.title: Pierre (Pierre Computer Company)
entries.summary: New activity signals: the pierrecomputer/icons repo is built for Diffs.com, Trees.software, and DiffsHub.com (the org's commercial surface), issue #728 requests a CLI surface for the toolkit, and recent commits show a [diffs/edit] refactor of the onChange editor option plus a bump to @pierre/diffs 1.3.0. The diff-editor surface is seeing ongoing work.

entries.title: t3code
entries.summary: The page pins the earlier Codex friction repro to T3 Code v0.0.4 (2026-03-07) and codex-cli 0.94.0, and adds a current issue stream: Codex slash commands (/help, /status, /use, /review) are missing from the T3Code surface (issue #2637) and Codex image-generation results lack first-class chat output (issue #2398). Concrete harness-surface gaps of the same class as issue #386.

entries.title: Open Questions
entries.summary: Two new open questions: whether OpenWiki emits OKF v0.1 (as its README says) or v0.2 (the current spec revision), and what OpenWiki's current npm release is — both unresolved because the pull returned repo docs but no release artifacts. The generative-UI SDK versions question was updated to note the re-surfaced Kotlin SDK docs tree.

entries.title: A2UI (Agent to UI) Protocol
entries.summary: Cross-reference fix: the A2UI-over-MCP, MCP-Apps-in-A2UI, and A2UI-in-MCP-Apps interop surfaces now link to the Model Context Protocol base page. No substantive change.

entries.title: AG-UI (Agent-User Interaction Protocol)
entries.summary: The page gains a source-backed Kotlin SDK section: community-maintained com.agui.* Gradle coordinates, Android/iOS/JVM stable at API 26+/iOS 13+/Java 11+, AgUiAgent/StatefulAgUiAgent clients on kotlinx.coroutines.flow, a Tools module with circuit-breaker patterns, chunked protocol events rewritten into start/content/end sequences, and THINKING_ telemetry surfaced for UIs. MCP cross-references were also fixed to point at the canonical Model Context Protocol page.

entries.title: Agent Host Protocol (AHP)
entries.summary: The Agent Host Protocol (AHP) is Microsoft's synchronized, multi-client state protocol for AI agent sessions, framed on JSON-RPC 2.0 with channel-based routing, immutable state, pure reducers, and write-ahead reconciliation.

entries.title: MCP Apps (Model Context Protocol Apps extension)
entries.summary: MCP Apps is the first official extension to the Model Context Protocol, co-developed by Anthropic and OpenAI, letting MCP servers deliver interactive UIs (charts, forms, dashboards) rendered securely in iframes inside any compliant host.

entries.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entries.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is the open standard for how AI agents integrate with external tools, data sources, and other agents — JSON-RPC 2.0-based tools, resources, and prompts with capability negotiation, sampling, elicitation, authorization, and a 2026-07-28 revision that made the core stateless, added Multi Round-Trip Requests, header-based routing, cacheable list results, and a formal extensions framework.

entries.title: Open Knowledge Format (OKF)
entries.summary: OKF is a minimal, vendor-neutral format for representing knowledge as markdown files with YAML frontmatter in a self-describing bundle — standardizing the small set of structural conventions (required type, provenance, trust, lifecycle, attestation) that make an agent-maintained knowledge corpus trustable.

entries.title: AI Knowledge Wiki Quickstart
entries.summary: Navigation and current status for the AI knowledge corpus — the Model Context Protocol (MCP) core and its 2026-07-28 stateless revision (added 2026-08-17), the Agent Host Protocol (AHP), Agent Client Protocol (ACP), the generative-UI / agent-UI protocol ecosystem (with the AG-UI Kotlin SDK and Cedar-OS deltas), the agentic SDLC factory toolchain (Pierre, t3code, Effect, OpenCode, Pi SDK, gh-aw CI workflows, and the followed blog feeds), and the agent-maintained knowledge-base layer (the Open Knowledge Format v0.2 spec and the OpenWiki CLI that maintains this wiki).

entries.title: Model Context Protocol releases
entries.summary: Versioned revision history of the Model Context Protocol specification and Tier 1 SDK beta posture — revisions 2025-03-26, 2025-06-18, 2025-11-25 (RC 2025-11-15), and the current stateless 2026-07-28 revision, plus beta SDK versions for TypeScript, Go, and C#.

entries.title: Recurring themes and trends
entries.summary: Compact index of recurring signals across the AI knowledge corpus — standardization and convergence of generative-UI / agent-UI protocols in 2026, the emerging agentic SDLC factory toolchain (including its CI-native gh-aw layer), and the emergence of agent-maintained knowledge-base formats and tooling (OKF v0.2, OpenWiki).
